related.title: Apache Arrow：validity bitmap 與欄式緩衝
related.titleEn: Apache Arrow: validity bitmaps and columnar buffers
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：追蹤落後副本錯過刪除後的同步，辨識過早清除 tombstone 的風險。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Trace synchronization of a replica that missed a deletion and identify premature tombstone collection risks. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 手工建立含 NULL 的 int32 欄，區分值緩衝與 validity bitmap。
related.differenceEn: Build an int32 column with NULLs and distinguish value buffers from validity bitmaps.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 刪除需保留版本化標記讓落後副本知道舊值應消失；回收依修復與保留政策而非立即刪除所有證據。 教學基準：20-10 = 10 deletion versus old-value timestamp gap；第二檢核：2/3*100 = 66.66666667 replicas initially aware of deletion percent。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
NULL 的實際值槽內容不能當有效值；bit 表示 validity，切片另有 offset，alignment 可能增加配置大小。 教學基準：10*4 = 40 value-buffer bytes；第二檢核：ceil(10/8) = 2 validity bytes。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Deletion retains versioned markers so lagging replicas know old values must disappear; collection depends on repair/retention policy. Teaching baseline: 20-10 = 10 deletion versus old-value timestamp gap; second check: 2/3*100 = 66.66666667 replicas initially aware of deletion percent. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

The stored payload of a NULL slot is not a valid value; validity bits,offsets and allocation alignment are separate. Teaching baseline: 10*4 = 40 value-buffer bytes; second check: ceil(10/8) = 2 validity bytes. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: CSV 資料契約：編碼、引用、型別與可重現匯入
related.titleEn: CSV contracts: encoding,quoting,types and reproducible import
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：追蹤落後副本錯過刪除後的同步，辨識過早清除 tombstone 的風險。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Trace synchronization of a replica that missed a deletion and identify premature tombstone collection risks. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 用標準CSV parser讀含逗號、換行與前導零ID，建立可追溯資料契約。
related.differenceEn: Use a CSV parser for commas,newlines and leading-zero IDs with a traceable data contract.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。

CSV是有引用規則的紀錄格式，不能用split逗號或逐行當紀錄；型別與編碼需額外契約。 教學基準：10+20+30 = 60 amount total；第二檢核：3 = 3 logical records。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。

Teaching baseline: 20-10 = 10 deletion versus old-value timestamp gap; second check: 2/3*100 = 66.66666667 replicas initially aware of deletion percent. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

CSV has quoting rules and cannot be parsed by comma splitting or treating every line as a record; types/encoding need contracts. Teaching baseline: 10+20+30 = 60 amount total; second check: 3 = 3 logical records. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.
